title: 'Magi' Creator Shinobu Ohtaka Begins New Manga 'Geek Crown'
content: The official X account of Magazine Pocket announced on Tuesday that Shinobu Ohtaka will begin serializing a new manga, titled Geek Crown ( Geek and Crown ), on the platform on October 27.

title: Fukakōryoku no I Love You Manga Gets Live-Action Film Next March
content: Shochiku announced on Tuesday that it is producing a live-action film of Mizuki Hoshino 's Fukakōryoku no I Love You (I Love You by Force Majeure) manga that will open in Japan on March 5, 2027.
